==About me==

''I first read The Eye of the World in eighth grade. Now well out of college, this wiki has been invaluable to me keeping track of the vast collection characters, names and plots as Brandon Sanderson brings the series in for the finale. I try to help out the community when I come upon undocumented nuggets of information.''
